verdict.rationale: The evidence shows human-facing online services (trademark filing, MyCIPO Patents login) and read-only bulk data downloads. None of it documents a system-to-system channel for software to transact with CIPO, such as system accounts, transmitter programs or batch filing providers, or a published enrollment path for one. Bulk data download is adjacent data access, not a transactional machine rail.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
